decoys.note: decoys keep the reviewers blind and are excluded from every score

supported_minutes_source: high_precision/hp_frames.parquet: frames whose motion_unsupported is false, each weighted by its interval to the next frame (the median interval for the last), over the analysed span; recordings tracking only (metrics_scope tracking_only or status not_real_time) excluded
bootstrap: recording-cluster bootstrap of reviewed precision per point: the scored recordings resampled with replacement, 2000 replicates, numpy default_rng(0) per point; percentile 95 percent interval and one-sided 5th percentile over the defined replicates
